data.name: Ekagrajay
data.gender_notes: Ekagrajay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Eka' which means 'One' and 'Agraj' which means 'Ruler'. The name Ekagrajay thus symbolizes the idea of being a sole ruler or a leader in one's domain. In Hindu mythology, Ekagrajay is also the name of a divine being who is believed to have the power to rule over all elements.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ekagrajay total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_sanskrit.name: Ekagraj
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Ekagrajay' is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Eka' meaning one, and 'Agraj' meaning king, ruler, victory, or god. Depending on the context, this name can mean 'One-King', 'One-Ruler', 'One-Victory', or 'One-God'.

in_hindi.name: एक-अग्राजय
in_hindi.meaning: एक (Ek) - वाकीय राजा (Agraj) - एक राजा (Ek Rajaa)
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम एक-अग्राजय संस्कृत स्वरूप से पहचानी जाती है जिसमें 'एक' (Ek) एक होता हुआ में दिया गया है और 'अग्राज' (Agraj) राजा या वाकीय राजा के सिवाय में विजय या देव के सिवाय में शब्द का मतलब है। यह नाम एक-राजा (Ek Rajaa) के रूप में बताया जाता है।

data.cultural_impact: The name Ekagrajay holds significant cultural importance as it reflects the Indian values of leadership, power, and authority. It is a powerful name that evokes a sense of admiration and respect. In India, where hierarchy and social order are deeply entrenched in the social structure, the name Ekagrajay can be seen as a reflection of the country's historical and cultural traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ekagrajay signifies the individual's inner strength and ability to rule over one's own thoughts, emotions, and actions. It is a reminder of the importance of self-mastery and self-discipline in achieving inner peace and enlightenment. The divine being Ekagrajay is believed to have complete control over all elements and is often invoked for protection, guidance, and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Ekagrajay means 'one-eyed victorious.' It symbolizes the inner strength and focus required to overcome challenges, much like Lord Shiva who is also known as Ekagraj or Ekagrya, the one with a single, powerful and unwavering gaze towards his goals.

historical_references.reference: Ekagrajya was a legendary king of the Ikshvaku dynasty, who ruled around 1400 BCE. He is believed to have gained the boon of invincibility from Lord Agni, the fire god. The name Ekagrajya signifies one who has conquered his senses and desires, and is thus, free from sensual pleasures.

Ekagrajya, also known as Ekangaraya, was a king of the Sisunaka branch of the Lunar Dynasty. He ruled around 400 BCE and is mentioned in the Mahabharata. He is described as a just and virtuous ruler, who performed great sacrifices and was a devotee of Lord Shiva.
historical_references.context: King of Sisunaka branch of the Lunar Dynasty
